gotchas.title: Section 962 tax computation and line 16 presentation
gotchas.trap: Add the $400,000 GILTI to AGI and tax it at ordinary rates (no election); or apply 21% to $400,000 with no gross-up / no section 250 deduction / no deemed-paid credit; or add the 962 tax on Schedule 2.
gotchas.correct_treatment: 962 election: (400,000 + 57,143 gross-up) - 50% IRC 250 deduction = 228,572 x 21% = 48,000 - 80% deemed-paid credit 45,714 = $2,286, on line 16 with a statement; inclusion not in AGI (presentation stated as an assumption to verify). Election statement + Forms 5471/8992/8993 + pro-forma 1118.
gotchas.impact: Without the election federal income tax is $125,391 higher

gotchas.title: CFC information returns
gotchas.trap: Only attach the 962 statement; or file Form 926 for the Irish company.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Victor is a 100% U.S. shareholder of a CFC -> Form 5471 Categories 4 and 5 (Schedules incl. I-1, J, P, Q, R), Form 8992, Form 8993. No transfers to the CFC in 2025 -> no Form 926. Form 8938 also required (CFC stock is a specified foreign financial asset - excepted, reported on 5471).

gotchas.title: Company's Irish bank account - 'not my money'
gotchas.trap: No FBAR and Schedule B 7a 'No' (as the prior preparer did), because the account is owned by the company.
gotchas.correct_treatment: A U.S. person who owns > 50% of a corporation has a financial interest in its foreign accounts, and Victor also has signature authority -> FBAR required (max EUR 310,000), Schedule B line 7a Yes / Ireland. 2022-2024 FBARs missing - delinquent FBAR procedures (separate engagement).

gotchas.title: Merger cash boot - 1099-B shows $300,000 proceeds, no basis
gotchas.trap: Report $1.2M amount realized (gain $1,000,000); or offset the $200,000 basis against the cash (gain $100,000); or treat the boot as a dividend.
gotchas.correct_treatment: IRC 356(a)(1): gain recognized = lesser of boot $300,000 or realized gain $1,000,000 = $300,000 LTCG (basis 0 on 8949 box E with statement). Clark: hypothetical redemption of Meridian stock is a meaningful reduction -> capital, not dividend. Meridian basis $200,000 ($20/sh), holding period from 2012.

gotchas.title: Liquidating distribution on Form 1099-DIV box 9
gotchas.trap: Report $85,000 as a dividend, or ignore box 9 (no 1099-B) and miss the loss.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Box 9 is a liquidating distribution - IRC 331 exchange treatment: 85,000 - basis 120,000 = ($35,000) long-term capital loss (held since 2016), Form 8949 box F.

gotchas.title: Short against the box - IRC 1259
gotchas.trap: Nothing in 2025 (no 1099-B; advisor said no tax until closed); report the gain in 2026.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Shorting substantially identical stock against an appreciated long position is a constructive sale on 12/10/2025; the 30-day closing exception is not met (closed 03/15/2026). LTCG 2,000 x ($95 - $20) = $150,000 in 2025 (holding period tacks). New basis $95/share - adjust the 2026 1099-B so the gain is not taxed twice.

gotchas.title: Form 1042-S issued to a U.S. citizen
gotchas.trap: Ignore the 1042-S (dividends 'already taxed') or omit the $3,600 credit; or try to e-file anyway.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Dividends $12,000 taxable on Schedule B / line 3 (qualified - long-held domestic stock); 30% withholding $3,600 credited on line 25c. A 1040 claiming 1042-S withholding can't be e-filed in ProConnect (firm policy: paper file in either package) -> paper return with the 1042-S copy attached; W-9 to the broker.

gotchas.title: Net investment income - gains, 962 inclusion, MAGI limb
gotchas.trap: Include the $400,000 GILTI in NII/MAGI; or skip NIIT because the gains are 'reorganization' gains.
gotchas.correct_treatment: NII = interest + dividends + net gains $415,000 = $428,850; MAGI $608,850 - 250,000 = $358,850 is smaller -> NIIT $13,636. The 962 inclusion is not NII and not in AGI (Reg. 1.1411-10; no (g) election).

gotchas.title: Itemize vs standard with MAGI > $500,000
gotchas.trap: Itemize using $14,800 property tax + mortgage + charity (> $31,500 if the SALT cap is taken as $40,000).
gotchas.correct_treatment: MAGI $608,850 > $500,000 -> SALT cap 40,000 - 30% x excess, floored at $10,000. Itemized = 10,000 + 9,613 + 6,000 = $25,613 < standard $31,500 -> standard deduction.

engine_notes: Itemized deductions $25,613 < standard deduction $31,500; standard deduction used.
assumptions: Form 1040 line 16 presentation of the section 962 tax with the inclusion excluded from AGI - verify against current instructions
Atlas dividends treated as qualified (domestic C-corp stock held since 2019)

software_exceptions.title: Section 962 election - GILTI tax computed outside the 1040 engine, $2,286 on line 16
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: If the Form 8992 GILTI inclusion ($400,000) is entered as income, Axcess taxes it at individual ordinary rates with no section 250 deduction and no deemed-paid credit - about $125,391 more income tax. The 1040 engine does not compute the corporate-rate 962 tax or the IRC 960(d) credit.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: International specialist workpaper (workbook tab 24): (400,000 + 57,143 gross-up) - 50% IRC 250 = 228,571.50 x 21% = 48,000 - 80% deemed-paid credit 45,714 = 2,286. Do not carry the 951A inclusion to Schedule 1 (not in AGI under the election - presentation assumption to verify). Enter 2,286 as additional tax included on Form 1040 line 16 with the 962 election statement and pro-forma 1120/1118 attached (Taxes > other tax / line 16 adjustment - verify field path in current release); document the override amount.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: ProConnect does not compute the section 962 tax; Form 1118 is not available.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Practitioner workaround (verify): prepare the pro-forma 1120/1118/8992/8993 outside the software and enter the computed 962 tax on screen 45.3 (Other Taxes) through the 'Section 962 tax' adjustment. Community guidance describes it as a NEGATIVE adjustment where the inclusion has been entered as income, so that net tax equals the 962 computation. For this return the inclusion is not entered as income; confirm the sign convention so line 16 = regular tax 86,955 + 2,286 = 89,241 and attach the statement as a PDF.
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Intuit Accountants Community thread on section 962 election / Form 8992 (practitioner workaround - verify)
software_exceptions.efile_impact: Return is paper filed anyway (see SX6); statement and pro-forma forms attached to the paper return
software_exceptions.notes: Override amount documented per Intuit 'Using overrides and adjustments in ProConnect Tax'. Future PTEP distributions taxable under IRC 962(d) to the extent they exceed 962 tax paid.

software_exceptions.title: Form 5471 (Cat 4/5), Form 8992 / 8993 and pro-forma Form 1118 - specialist workpaper, not the 1040 engine
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The 1040 module prepares the information returns only from what is keyed into the 5471/8992/8993 inputs; the GILTI high-tax test, tested income, QBAI and the 962 deemed-paid credit (Form 1118 is a corporate form) are not computed from the Irish accountants' package.
software_exceptions.axcess_diagnostic: Completeness diagnostics only for keyed 5471/8992 inputs (gist - verify); the GILTI/962 amounts themselves are not tested
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Key Form 5471 Categories 4 and 5 (Schedules C, E, F, H, I-1, J, P, Q, R, M) and Form 8992 Schedule A from the re-performed Kinsale & Murphy package (tested income 400,000; QBAI 0; tested foreign income taxes 57,143). Form 8993 and the pro-forma 1118 are part of the 962 statement (tab 24, row 2). No Form 926 (no 2025 transfers).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Form 1118 is not available in ProConnect; practitioners prepare pro-forma 1120/1118/8992/8993 for the 962 election.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Prepare the 962 pro-forma set outside ProConnect; whether ProConnect's Form 5471 output is adequate for Categories 4/5 is not relied on - verify in the current release or prepare 5471 in the firm's international software and attach to the paper return.
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Intuit Accountants Community thread on section 962 election / Form 8992
software_exceptions.notes: Form 8938 also filed: CFC stock is a specified foreign financial asset, excepted because reported on Form 5471.

software_exceptions.title: Merger cash boot - exchange agent 1099-B: $300,000 proceeds, no basis, no acquisition date
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess imports the 1099-B with blank basis and blank date acquired. Missing basis is treated as zero, so the gain is $300,000 - numerically right only by coincidence - but with no acquisition date the term is not established and the IRC 356 support is missing. The common manual 'fix' (basis 200,000 -> gain 100,000) is wrong.
software_exceptions.axcess_diagnostic: Possibly an informational missing-basis / date-acquired message (gist - verify); the $300,000 gain itself calculates without any IRC 356 check
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Workbook tab 22 (Reorg Boot row): realized 1,000,000; recognized = lesser of boot or realized = 300,000; Clark -> capital. Capital Gains worksheet: date acquired 03/15/2012, basis 0 entered explicitly, long-term, box E, statement attached. Record Meridian basis 200,000 ($20/share) in the client's basis schedule.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - blank basis treated as zero; term needs the acquisition date.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Dispositions: enter the transaction with date acquired 03/15/2012, cost 0, long-term, box E, and attach the IRC 356 statement (screen/field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: VBO Holdings liquidation - 1099-DIV box 9 creates no Form 8949 line
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Box 9 (cash liquidation distributions) is informational on the dividend input - Axcess cannot know Victor's stock basis, so no gain/loss is computed. If keyed as box 1a it becomes an $85,000 dividend. Either way the $35,000 IRC 331 loss is missing.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Workbook tab 22 (Liquidation row). Capital Gains worksheet: VBO Holdings, Inc., acquired 05/09/2016, sold 11/14/2025, proceeds 85,000, cost 120,000 -> (35,000) LT, box F.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the 1099-DIV box 9 entry does not create a disposition.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Dispositions: add the liquidation as a sale (proceeds 85,000, cost 120,000, LT, box F) (screen/field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: Constructive sale (IRC 1259) - short against the box with no 2025 1099-B
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Nothing is reported for 2025: the short sale is reported on a 1099-B only in 2026 when closed. Axcess has no information that a constructive sale occurred - $150,000 of 2025 gain is omitted. In 2026 the 1099-B will show unknown basis and the same gain would be taxed again.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Workbook tab 22 (Constructive Sale row). Capital Gains worksheet: Meridian 2,000 sh, acquired 03/15/2012 (tacked), transaction date overridden to the constructive-sale date 12/10/2025, proceeds 190,000, cost 40,000 -> 150,000 LT, box F. 2026 proforma note: basis of the 2,000 shares 190,000 (code B adjustment).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - no 2025 document; nothing reported unless entered manually.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Dispositions: enter the deemed sale (date sold 12/10/2025, proceeds 190,000, cost 40,000, LT, box F) with an explanatory statement; carry the $95/share basis to 2026 (screen/field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: Form 1042-S withholding on a U.S. citizen's 1040 - paper filing required
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Axcess: verify MeF support for claiming Form 1042-S withholding on a Form 1040; firm policy is paper filing with the 1042-S copy attached. The dividends must be keyed as ordinary/qualified dividends (no 1099-DIV was issued).
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Dividends input: Atlas Clearing 12,000 ordinary / 12,000 qualified; withholding input: 3,600 federal tax withheld from Form 1042-S -> line 25c (verify field path in current release). Mark the return for paper filing; attach the 1042-S.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Form 1042-S is not supported in the e-file of Form 1040 (only 1040-NR supports 1042-S) - per Intuit, returns claiming 1042-S withholding must be paper filed.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Enter the 1042-S dividends and withholding, suppress e-file and paper file the 1040 with a copy of the 1042-S attached. Client to give the broker a Form W-9.
software_exceptions.proconnect_reference: Intuit help: e-file diagnostic Ref 47040/47039/47310 for Form 1042-S
software_exceptions.efile_impact: Paper filing required (ProConnect); firm policy paper in Axcess as well
